title: The Spacecraft That Flew Farther Than Apollo
description: In late 2022, NASA launched the Artemis I mission to test the uncrewed Orion capsule around the Moon. The historic flight pushed human spaceflight hardware farther into deep space than ever before.

shots.narration: This capsule flew farther from Earth than any spacecraft built for humans.
Artemis I launched on 16 November 2022 aboard the Space Launch System, the most powerful rocket ever to fly at the time.
The uncrewed Orion capsule flew for 25.5 days, travelling deep into the lunar environment.
Here, cameras on Orion's solar arrays filmed Earth and the Moon together against deep space.
At its farthest point, Orion reached 432,000 kilometres from Earth.
Inside the commander's seat sat a mannequin wired with sensors, nicknamed Commander Moonikin Campos.
Re-entering the atmosphere at about 40,000 kilometres per hour, its heat shield reached around 2,800 °C.
Orion completed its journey when it splashed down safely in the Pacific Ocean on 11 December 2022.
